dataset.selection_rule: Take the 32 lowest SHA-256 digests of UTF-8 seed + NUL + config + NUL + original filename, without content, duration, quality, or output filtering. Order is ascending digest.

application.cli_template: python transcribe.py transcribe AUDIO --model MODEL --language en --threads THREADS --output OUTPUT

metric_definition.WER: Sum word substitutions + deletions + insertions, divided by summed reference words.
metric_definition.CER: Same normalized-string minimum edit distance at character level, including single spaces.
metric_definition.normalization: Identical score.py: Unicode NFKC/casefold; letters, marks and numbers retained; punctuation/symbols become spaces; collapse whitespace; accents and Cyrillic ё retained; no number-word conversion.

execution: Fresh CLI process per clip, sequential; no previous results reused; CPU int8; offline local model; wall time includes CLI/model startup.
limits: Small fixed short-read-speech sample, not long-recording accuracy.
Languages explicitly supplied, not language-autodetection accuracy.
Public test partition is not proof of exclusion from model pretraining.
Punctuation, case and semantic correctness are not directly scored.
